attemptsBeforeInference.result: sandbox EPERM on local API; no inference
api/show strict equality rejected parameter display ordering only; no inference

normalization: Compare sorted parameter lines and all other api/show fields unchanged; model digest, values, template and server version must match. No model setting modified.
recording: Request template stored once in protocol.json; combine system message and JSON.stringify({content: input.content}) to reconstruct each request. trials.jsonl stores actual request hash, raw HTTP response and validated evidence once per trial.
reproduction: Set EVAL_BUILD to an external build directory and EVAL_OUT to a new empty output directory; run run.mjs from repository root. After inspecting first-trial-check.json and first saved trial, create EVAL_OUT/continue. Original baseline records must remain accessible.
newInputs: Design-reviewed, not unseen holdout; no generalization claim.
memoryRetention: Raw vm_stat and swap output retained; ps output reduced to Ollama-related process lines after capture to omit unrelated process inventory. Sampling interval about 1 second; initial verification gate included.
sourceArchive: source-snapshot.tar.gz preserves original source bytes including existing trailing spaces; source/build hashes in protocol.json.
